{"section04_html": "

The taxpayer was not a "casual taxable person" as defined, because the stall was a one-day exhibition sale below the threshold.

", "section05_html": "
  1. Para 3: Denied. The definition in Section 2(20) is not met.
  2. Para 5(b): Denied. Section 129 applies to goods in transit, not to a stall.
", "section06_html": "

Section 129 is confined to detention of goods in transit and cannot found a penalty for want of registration.

", "citations": [], "strength_note": "Moderate: depends on turnover evidence.", "documents": ["Sales register for the exhibition", "Stall allotment letter"], "summary_line": "No casual taxable person registration was required; Section 129 does not apply."}
